topic: The Origin and Color Dependence of the Index of Refraction

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Harmonic Oscillator Model
lecture_lines: Electrons act like masses on springs.
Light wave pushes electrons to oscillate.
animations: Display a spring-mass system with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mass.svg] labeled '#FFFFFF' and a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/spring.svg] labeled '#FFD700'.
Oscillate the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mass.svg] horizontally; change label color to '#00FFFF' to signify movement.
Fade in a sine wave graph tracking the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mass.svg] displacement.
Highlight the equilibrium point of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/spring.svg] with a pulsing '#FF00FF' circle.

Animate the wave frequency increasing; [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mass.svg] oscillates faster attached to the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/spring.svg].

sections.title: Origin: Light-Matter Interaction
lecture_lines: These waves lag behind incident light.
animations: Display an incoming light wave (sinusoidal) as an oscillating vector.
Show the light wave entering a dense atomic medium containing an [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/atom.svg].
Animate the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/electron.svg] oscillation reacting to the light wave field.
Show the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/electron.svg] emitting a secondary spherical re-radiation wave.
Illustrate the interference of the incident and re-radiated waves within the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/atom.svg].

sections.title: Mechanism: Color Dependence (Dispersion)
animations: Show atoms with varying natural electron resonant frequencies.
Animate incident waves of low, medium, and high frequencies.
Highlight electrons oscillating with amplitude dependent on frequency.

sections.title: Visualizing Dispersion: The Rainbow Effect
animations: Display a white light beam entering [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg].
Show the beam splitting into constituent colors (ROYGBIV) inside [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg].
Flash the varying refraction angles for each color output from [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg].

sections.title: Real-World Application: Chromatic Aberration
animations: Show a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lens.svg] focusing white light onto a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sensor.svg].
